clauses.title: CL-D77 records that autofix drafts the owner publication artifacts at every terminal outcome
clauses.section: ## CL-D77 — Every exact-autofix run ends with the owner publication artifacts
requires: *Owner choice:* Option A

the owner executing the generated script remains the one owner-approved comment action
The autofix grant does not widen

the report states `not_drafted(<reason>)`
refuses a draft pull request, and binds the base OID and the head repository and branch at its first identity read

clauses.title: The publisher refuses a draft pull request and a moved base or head branch
requires: [.base.repo.full_name, (.number|tostring), .state, (.draft|tostring), .head.sha, .html_url, .base.sha, (.head.repo.full_name // ""), .head.ref] | map(. // "" | tostring) as $fields | if any($fields[]; contains("\u001f") or contains("\u0000") or contains("\n")) then error("identity field contains a forbidden control character") else ($fields | join("\u001f")) end
[[ "$actual_draft" == 'false' ]] || fail "pull request is a draft at $phase"
fail "pull-request base OID, head repository, or head branch changed at $phase"
fail "pull-request head repository is missing at $phase"
IFS=$'\x1f' read -r

clauses.title: README names what the generated publisher rechecks
requires: The generated publisher rechecks the exact repository, an open non-draft PR, the reviewed head, the base OID and head repository and branch it first read, complete body digest
Review-only keeps its own no-publication grant; its generated publisher carries the same CL-D77 identity checks.

clauses.title: CL-D33 states what CL-D77 changed in it
clauses.section: ## CL-D33 — Review-only drafts guarded owner-executed PR publication artifacts
requires: CL-D77 later extended the drafting of these artifacts to every exact-autofix terminal outcome whose repository, pull request, and public head are resolved, and strengthened the template's identity checks for both modes, under its own decision.
